# Vivaan Marketing

> B2B SaaS marketing agency specialising in AI search visibility. We make brands the source that ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, Perplexity, Gemini and Claude cite when buyers ask about their category, backed by SEO and content marketing programmes.

Based in Ahmedabad, India. Serving B2B technology companies in the United States, United Kingdom, Canada, Australia and India. Contact: devmurari.sachin87@gmail.com

## Definitions we use

- **Answer Engine Optimization (AEO)**: structuring content so AI answer engines can extract, understand and cite it directly. Page-level and on-site.
- **Generative Engine Optimization (GEO)**: shaping how AI models understand, describe and recommend a brand, through entity clarity, schema and third-party corroboration. Brand-level and largely off-site.
- **AI visibility**: how often and how accurately generative engines cite a brand for its category's buyer questions.

## Services

- [Answer Engine Optimization Services (AEO) for B2B SaaS](https://vivaanmarketing.com/services/answer-engine-optimization/): AEO services that get your brand quoted in ChatGPT, Perplexity and Google AI Overviews. Answer blocks, schema, entity clarity and citation tracking for B2B SaaS.
- [Generative Engine Optimization Services (GEO) for B2B Brands](https://vivaanmarketing.com/services/generative-engine-optimization/): GEO services that build the entity clarity and third-party corroboration AI models need to cite you. For Google AI Overviews, Gemini, ChatGPT and Claude.
- [B2B SaaS SEO Agency](https://vivaanmarketing.com/services/b2b-saas-seo/): B2B SaaS SEO services: topical authority mapping, keyword clustering, technical fixes and internal linking that compound into qualified pipeline, not vanity traffic.
- [B2B Content Marketing Agency](https://vivaanmarketing.com/services/content-marketing/): B2B content marketing agency: quarterly editorial strategy, content calendars, distribution playbooks and reporting mapped to pipeline KPIs.

## Offers

- **Free AI Visibility Audit** (0 USD): citation map across ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews and Gemini, brand description check, competitor citation analysis, structural diagnosis and a prioritised fix list. Intake is a three-line form at https://vivaanmarketing.com/free-ai-visibility-audit/#request. Delivered by email within five business days. No call required.
